Portal won't load or a tile is black? Click for fixes →

Tile is black or stuck? Refresh that tab. The wizard auto-recovers on a fresh load (ws-scrcpy occasionally misses codec init on a second client joining an already-streaming server; a refresh re-handshakes cleanly).

Portal page won't load on a PC (other PCs work fine)? Your home router is DNS-blocking *.trycloudflare.com subdomains. Fix in Chrome / Edge in 30 seconds — no admin needed:

  1. Open browser Settings
  2. Privacy and security → Security
  3. Toggle Use secure DNS on, choose "With Cloudflare (1.1.1.1)" (or Google)
  4. Reload this page

For a whole-LAN fix, log into the router and disable DNS rebind protection / DNS filtering — or allow-list trycloudflare.com.
